# Loading Packages and Data

```{r, warning=F, results='hide'}
#installing the ctv package to have access to the other ones
install.packages("ctv")
library(ctv)
ctv::install.views("TimeSeries", coreOnly = TRUE)
# Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
```

Loading of dataset

```{r}
JNTO_dat <- read_csv("JNTO - Trends in Visitor Arrivals to Japan.csv")

#look at structure of the data
str(JNTO_dat)
```

So structurally the data is not the way that I want it to be since it has the year and date separate and then also , I'm not interested in the countries that come from, more so that they are foreigners, so basically i am interested in the aggregate.

Therefore we first need to:

- combine the date and month together

- convert to a Date variable

- remove column for countries as well as for growth rate

- convert to a time series object

```{r}
data <- JNTO_dat |> 
  mutate(, Date = paste(Year,`Month (abbr)`))

data <- data[,-c(1,2)] # removes the month and year columns


#make date the first row
data <- data |> 
  select(Date , everything())

#convert Date column into type date
data$Date <- ym(data$Date)
day(data$Date) <- days_in_month(data$Date) # made it reflect the end of the month values 

dat <- data |> 
  group_by(Date) |> 
  summarize(Total_Visitors = if (all(is.na(`SUM(Visitor Arrivals)`))) NA_real_ else sum(`SUM(Visitor Arrivals)`, na.rm = TRUE))

# data isnt available for after may 2026 so remove that from the dataset 
cleaned_data <- dat |> 
  filter(Date < '2026-06-30')

summary(cleaned_data)
```

Total observations: 437 minus from June 2026.

grouped them by date and found totals because I am not interested in countries but rather in the total number of foreigners visited

```{r}
save(cleaned_data, file = "cleaned_data.Rdata")
```
